Sebi Approves IPOs for Zetwerk, Tonbo Imaging, and Others

India's Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) has granted approval for Initial Public Offerings (IPOs) for several companies, including Zetwerk and Tonbo Imaging. Zetwerk has an 18-month period to complete its listing, while Tonbo Imaging has a 12-month window. The approvals signal potential new investment opportunities in the market.
